heading: You can protect the mission or goal or you can protect the result of a means of pursuing ur goal.
text:
You can protect the mission or goal or you can protect the result of a means of pursuing ur goal.

One will have you keep chasing uneding one will have you convinced you have arrived en should never leave, both can mislead you eventualy at some point, en each can lead you to the other unknowingly 

---

Yeah what rise is to fall. Thats not failure that return to its natural form.

But true innovator is one who figure how to dissamble their current form en start in a different form while keeping knowledge en experience of previous forms en use them to optimize their new form while its still useful 

---
Ofcourse its not easy, else every everyone will be doing it. To never die en live forever while not radicating death entirely then you have to learn to die today en awake tomorrow everytime, you may not have defeated death but you wilk keep surviving until you find proper solutions.
